_comment: PRE-REGISTERED. These floors were fixed before any lineup-level result was
computed, and CI asserts this file's hash is unchanged. Loosening a floor to
make a demo look better is therefore a build failure, not a judgement call.
The possession floor comes from arithmetic, not taste. A lineup's offensive
rating has a standard error of about 115/sqrt(n) per 100 possessions. At 200
possessions that is +/-8.1, against a true between-lineup spread of roughly
6-8. Below 200 the measurement is noisier than the entire signal, so a point
estimate there is not a weak claim -- it is a meaningless one.
